# Invalid Usage
Usage: `&voicecount <on|off|channel> [channel mention or ID]`

**Commands:**
• `&voicecount on` - Enable voice count system
• `&voicecount off` - Disable voice count system
• `&voicecount channel <channel>` - Set voice count channel (text or voice)

# Invalid Subcommand
